name.$: NINGDE CONTEMPORARY AMPEREX TECH CO LTD

invention-title.$: Solid-state battery clamp, solid-state battery and battery manufacturing equipment
固态电池夹具、固态电池以及电池制造设备

p.$: The utility model discloses a solid-state battery clamp, a solid-state battery and battery manufacturing equipment, and the solid-state battery clamp is used in the process of carrying out temperature isostatic pressing on the solid-state battery. The solid-state battery clamp comprises a shell and a clamping assembly, the shell is provided with a containing cavity and comprises a bottom wall. The clamping assembly is used for clamping the edge of the solid-state battery, and the clamping assembly is arranged in the containing cavity and slidably connected with the bottom wall. Wherein in the warm isostatic pressing process, when hydraulic oil applies hydrostatic pressure to the packaging film of the solid-state battery and causes the edge of the packaging film to contract towards the center of the solid-state battery, the clamping assembly is configured to be capable of responding to the contraction of the packaging film to slide inwards relative to the bottom wall so as to follow the movement of the edge. According to the technical scheme, dynamic deformation of the clamped workpiece in the machining process can be self-adapted, and the risk that a packaging film of the solid-state battery is damaged is reduced.

[0001]    本申请公开了一种固态电池夹具、固态电池以及电池制造设备，固态电池夹具，用于固态电池进行温等静压过程中。固态电池夹具包括壳体以及夹持组件。壳体具有容纳腔，壳体包括底壁。夹持组件用于夹持固态电池的边缘，夹持组件设于容纳腔内并与底壁可滑动连接。其中，在温等静压过程中，当液压油对固态电池的包装膜施加静水压力并致使包装膜的边缘向固态电池中心收缩时，夹持组件被配置为能够响应于包装膜的收缩而相对底壁向内滑动，以跟随边缘的移动。本申请实施例的技术方案，能够自适应被夹持工件在加工过程中的动态形变，减少固态电池的包装膜发生破损的风险。

name.$: SHANGHAI SAIC QINGTAO ENERGY TECH CO LTD
上海上汽清陶能源科技有限公司

invention-title.$: Preparation method of all-solid-state battery and all-solid-state battery
一种全固态电池的制备方法及全固态电池

p.$: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery production, and relates to a preparation method of an all-solid-state battery and the all-solid-state battery. A first negative electrode material strip and a first electrolyte material strip are compounded to form a first base material strip, and a first supporting frame material strip with a first placing hole is placed on the first base material strip; the positive plate is placed in the first placing hole, and the laminated body is formed by cutting after compounding, so that the problem of alignment of the positive plate and the negative plate can be avoided. And in addition, a continuous material belt preparation mode is adopted, so that the production efficiency is improved. Besides, the first placing hole can limit the position of the positive plate after being placed, and the projection of the first negative material belt in the width direction falls on the first supporting frame material belt, so that the first supporting frame material belt can play a role in supporting the areas on the two sides of the first negative material belt in the width direction; and a certain supporting effect is achieved on the overhang area of the negative plate formed after cutting, cracking or fracture of the overhang area is avoided, and the quality of a battery cell is guaranteed.

本发明属于锂离子电池生产技术领域，涉及一种全固态电池的制备方法及全固态电池，通过将第一负极料带和第一电解质料带复合形成第一基材料带，并将带有第一放置孔的第一支撑框料带放置在第一基材料带上，将正极片放入第一放置孔内，复合后进行裁切形叠片体，能够避免正负极片对齐的问题。并且，采用连续的料带的制备方式，还有助于提高了生产效率。另外，第一放置孔能够对正极片放置后的位置进行限位，第一负极料带在宽度方向上的投影落在第一支撑框料带上，使得第一支撑框料带能够对第一负极料带宽度方向上两边区域起到支撑作用，对裁切后形成的负极片的overhang区域起到一定支撑作用，避免overhang区域的开裂或断裂，保证电池电芯的质量。

name.$: ANHUI GUOXUAN NEW ENERGY AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD
安徽国轩新能源汽车科技有限公司

invention-title.$: 一种固态电池模块保护装置

p.$: The utility model relates to the technical field of solid-state batteries, and discloses a solid-state battery module protection device which comprises a protection shell, a partition plate is clamped in the protection shell, a communicating pipe is arranged at the top of the partition plate, a hollow communicating column is installed on one side face of the partition plate, and a through hole is formed in the communicating column. A plurality of air nozzles arranged at intervals are installed on the outer wall of the side, away from the partition plate, of the communicating column, the interior of the communicating pipe is communicated with the interior of the communicating column through a flow guide pipe, an air suction pump is installed outside the protective shell, and an air suction opening of the air suction pump is communicated with the interior of the communicating pipe. The air tap is connected with an air extracting pump through a communicating pipe and a communicating column, and the air extracting pump is used for achieving the automatic dust collecting function on the air tap; and the air tap is designed to be inclined downwards, so that the air tap can be accurately aligned to the connection part of the end part of the battery, dust accumulation is avoided, the contact resistance is reduced, the current transmission efficiency is improved, and potential safety hazards such as short circuit and overheating caused by dust are remarkably reduced.

本实用新型涉及固态电池技术领域，公开了一种固态电池模块保护装置，包括防护壳，所述防护壳的内部卡接有分隔板，所述分隔板的顶部设置有连通管，所述分隔板的一侧面安装有中空的连通柱，所述连通柱远离分隔板的一侧外壁安装有若干个间隔设置的气嘴，所述连通管的内部通过导流管与连通柱的内部连通，所述防护壳的外部安装有抽气泵，抽气泵的吸风口与连通管的内部相连通，本实用新型在分隔板一侧设置气嘴，并通过连通管、连通柱与抽气泵连接，利用抽气泵实现对气嘴的自动吸尘功能；气嘴采用向下倾斜设计，能够精准地对准电池端部连接处，避免灰尘积聚，不仅减少接触电阻，提升了电流传输效率，还显著降低了因灰尘引发的短路、过热等安全隐患。
